name: ANSI/IEEE voltage transformer symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for voltage transformer, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The potential-transformer form identifies a voltage measurement interface in the IEEE-oriented vendor library. Power connection, winding polarity and secondary protection are read as instrument-transformer information rather than as a general power-supply transformer.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace both primary voltage connections and the secondary input circuit.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Potential transformer is a common name for a VT; a shared word does not make it a CT.
